rows.en: Hey! Are you all right!? Damn, how could this happen!
Hey! Are you all right!? Damn, how could this happen!
Kyaaaah!
Uwaaaah!
Uwaaaah!
Nngh… Why? Why doesn't my boomerang work!? You'll pay for this, Zero-One and the rest of you!
Boomerang, boomerang… Next time, I'll beat you for sure!
Nngh… Shadow Robot jersey number 37 is a retired number that lives forever!
To destroy the Neo-Mechagiant that suddenly appeared in the heart of the city, Bioman took the Bio Robo and sortied!
Miki, the mecha-human girl who came to know suffering and conflict because she came to know the human heart. The answer she reached as a human brought about an all-too-sad ending.
But Miki and the humans strove to help each other until the very end, in spite of their fate as human and machine…… And that would reveal a ray of hope in this war.

Even androids that know only destruction as enemies should be able to understand us, as Miki did, if only they are fitted with a Conscience Circuit… A path to a peaceful resolution of this war had begun to appear, if only a little.
Ichiro and Jiro hid the girl who called herself Mari at the Snack Amigo. And a week was about to pass.
Defeat Bijinder and all Shadowmen!
Defeat all Shadowmen!
Defeat Bijinder!
Defeat Kaimen Green and all Androidmen!
Defeat all Androidmen!
Defeat all the Shadowmen, Red-Face Turtle, Hell Kappa, Shadow Knight and Bijinder!
Defeat all the Shadowmen, Red-Face Turtle, Hell Kappa, Kaimen Green and the Androidmen!
Ichiro or Hayato Ichimonji is defeated
Ichiro, Hayato Ichimonji or Mari is defeated
Mari is defeated
<c3>Shadow Moon</c>'s HP went down!
What are you dawdling for, Shadow Moon? Have you forgotten that I told you to retake the King Stone as soon as possible?
Why are you in such a hurry, Creation King…?

Behold! This giant sunspot appears once every fifty thousand years…

When this sunspot vanishes, my life will end too! It is Gorgom's law that the next Creation King be decided before then!

Listen, Shadow Moon! There is little time left before the sunspot vanishes… Before then, you must take the King Stone from Black Sun at all costs!
Understood! This time, I'll finish Black Sun with my own hands…
I expect great things of you, Shadow Moon!
A giant sunspot that appears every fifty thousand years… The Creation King, whose life was about to end along with its disappearance, urged Shadow Moon to recover the King Stone.
And at last, Shadow Moon issued a final declaration of war on humanity, to defeat the Riders with his own hands!

Hm?

What's wrong, Kotaro? You haven't eaten a thing. Are you feeling sick or something?
You're worried about Nobuhiko, aren't you?
Fighting someone who used to be your friend… it's hard.
But we…

It's fine, really! I'm all right!

Hahaha… Come on, Oyassan! I'm full of energy, see?

Look… my appetite's just fine…

Is that so? Well, if you say so…

Still, I'm kinda worri…!?
Big news!
We've found out where Destron's cyborg factory in Japan is!
What!? A cyborg factory?
I see… If we blow up the factory, Destron won't be able to make Combatants or monsters!
I see… All right, let's hit Destron's factory!
All right, Kotaro! You come too!
Ah… right!
He's like a brother to you, isn't he, that friend of yours… It's certainly hard. But we…
Whoa… Look out!
What's going on? Why is everyone in such a hurry…?

Oh, you're back…

Well, they said they found Destron's cyborg factory or something, and they all went flying off…

Anyway… sorry about that, asking you to run errands for me…
I'll say… Look at all these bags!
Ho… So you're a woman after all, [HERO4]? Shopping's the best way to blow off stress, eh…
But… I don't know what's causing that stress! I sense some enormous power…
Whoa… Wh-whoa, whoa…
Kotaro, watch it! What's with everyone? Why are they all in such a hurry…?
Phew… Give me a break already! Look at all these bags!
Ho… So you're a girl after all, [HERO4]? Shopping's the best way to blow off stress, eh…
Yeah, but… I have no idea what's causing the stress… I sense some huge power, though?
This is the place, no doubt… The factory is past this entrance.

All right… Yuki and I will deal with the Destron Combatants!

Senpai, Kotaro, go in through the back and set the bombs!
Right, got it!
Let's go, Kotaro!
Right!
This is it, right? The factory is past this entrance.

All right… I'll deal with the Destron Combatants!

Senpai, Kotaro, go in through the back and set the bombs!
Looks like… it worked.
Too late… I was one step too late!
Who's there!?

Curse you… How dare you blow up Destron's cyborg factory!

You Kamen Riiiders! I, Doktor G, will kill every last one of you!
Doktor G…!? Destron Executive!
The traitor, Joji Yuki…? I'll dispose of you along with them!

Black Sun…

Settle things with Shadow Moon before the sunspot vanishes! Hurry, Black Sun!
Ngh, you Kamen Riiiders! Next time we meet, your lives are mine! Don't you forget it!
Doktor G…
I have been waiting for you, Great Leader…
I see… So you are prepared? As expected of a Destron Executive!

The information leaked to them… and full responsibility for the destruction of the cyborg factory lies with me…

But there remains just one way… for Destron to succeed in its operation to wipe out Japan… in other words, the death of those Kamen Riiiders!

Great Leader, great Leader of Destron! Give me, Doktor G, one last chance… the chance to fight those Riiiders!

I grant it… Doktor G!

Fight the Riders with the pride of a Destron Executive! Fight, and defeat them!

Then your name shall be remembered forever as a great warrior of Destron…
The rite of the Holy Spirit of the Devil's Warriors…
Ancient warriors… Holy Spirit of the eternal, undying Devil's Warriors! Bestow your great power upon Doktor G!
Welcome!
Nice weather again today, isn't it?

uncertain: U11708: 背番号37は、不滅のナンバー - baseball-style "retired number" joke; kept.
U11709: Bioman, Neo-Mechagiant and Bio Robo are not in the glossary (romanized; see new_names). This line seems to come from a different context; translated as written.
U11710-U11712: one narration over three rows; 苔え read as 答え, 一訖 as 一筋 "a ray"; the double ellipsis "……" kept.
U11713: スナックアミーゴ rendered "Snack Amigo".
U11724: system message, formatted like the B0001 Morale messages ("HP went down").
U11736: 貪欲 read as 食欲 "appetite".
U11745: Hongo refers to Nobuhiko as Kotaro's brother (they were raised as brothers); "He's like a brother to you".
U11746-U11747 and U11752-U11753: [HERO4] almost run over by the departing Riders; continuations are narration-kind.
U11750/U11755: Tobei's dated remark kept at the same strength.
U11758/U11763: 先輩 rendered "Senpai" (Shiro to Hongo/Ichimonji).
U11767/U11771/U11775: Doktor G's drawn-out ラ～イダ rendered "Riiider".
U11777-U11778: 聖霍 read as 聖霊 "Holy Spirit".
U11779-U11780: Tobei greeting a customer; continues in B0148.
omissions_kept: U11735: Hongo's "But we…" left unfinished (cut by Kotaro).
